title: CPG Edge Event
description: Mot canh (edge) trong Code Property Graph noi 2 node. Publish len topic 'code.events.edges'. Message KEY = file_path (gom moi event cua cung 1 file vao cung partition). Chong trung dua vao Cypher MERGE theo edge_id trong payload, khong dua vao Kafka key.

event_timestamp.description: Event-time: thoi diem parser sinh ra canh nay (ISO 8601 UTC).

edge_id.description: Stable ID = sha256(edge_type + source_node_id + target_node_id + [bien DFG neu co]). On dinh qua cac lan parse.

edge_type.description: Loai canh: AST (cha-con trong cay cu phap), CFG (luong dieu khien), DFG (luong du lieu def-use), CALL (ham goi ham).

dfg_variable.description: Chi dung cho canh DFG: ten bien duoc def o source va use o target. null voi cac loai canh khac.

repo_commit.description: Commit hash cua repo luc parse.
